notes.title: New Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New update was released!

Change log:
- 5 New Cars added: Skyline GTR33, Evo 8, 911 Turbo RWB, Altezza, Mira!
- Fixed Chat!
- Fixed Civic swaps: allowed only 4 cylinder engines!
- Fixed widescreens!
- Fixed pvp bugs!
- A lot of small bug fixes!

Enjoy the game! And stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: New Update 1.0.5
New Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello to every kanjo racer! New update is released!

Change log:
- Added new car: RX7 RC!
- Added new wheels!
- Added PvP 1vs1 races!
- Added Free camera Cinematic mode!
- Improved grip phyiscs!
- Added downforce (Bumbers, Wings are affecting the downforce)
- Auto Hidding cursor!
- Online Races Fixes!
- Stuck on loading screen fix
- Fixed traffic spawn!
- Fixed manual rev limiter!
- Chat words filter!
- Small fixes!

Hope you're enjoying the game!
Please be patient for new updates!

notes.title: New Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello to every kanjo racer!
New Update released! 1.0.3

Change Log:
- Drift Tracks performance optimizations!
- Fixed lighting lamps bug on 25% textures size!
- Added Chat!
- Added Neon!
- Added new oldschool rims!
- Added new rewards in online races! 20k for 1 place, 10k for second etc!
- Space bar to close the race finish and chase UI!
- A lot of small fixes!

Thank you for playing and supporting the community! 
Follow for new updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Online races fixes
- Game Volume setting
- Online race join hot key (Press Enter)
- Controller vibration
- New Camera modes (Press V)
- Small bugs fixes

EDIT: 
Forget to mention: Custom imported liveries
there is a folder in KanjozokuGame_Data/livery
There are the templates for every car, so you can make any livery you want and just put it in folder the game will load it!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed auto accepting race invitation
- Fixed players crashing sounds
- Fixed online traffic collision bugs
- Vsync added
- Minimum speed race conditions fixed from 60 to 100 km/h
- Added feature to sell cars
- Added offline mode

notes.title: First Version Released!
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone who has been waiting for the game!
I am glad to inform you - the first version is released now!
